Card Q&A.a: No. You didn't have 10 cards in your trash until after the deletion already took place, so this Digimon's inherited effect could not be active at the time of the deletion.
Card Q&A.q: I have 9 cards in my trash and a Digimon with this card as a digivolution card is deleted in battle. The deleted cards, including this one, are sent to my trash, and now I have over 10 cards in my trash. Does  in this card's inherited effects activate and delete my opponent's Digimon it battled?

Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While there are 10 or more cards in your trash, this Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞. (When this Digimon is deleted in battle, delete the Digimon it battled.)
